10

12	direction (`PrimeDivisor.point_ne_genericPoint`, elementary, proved there) and a *producing*

15	`WeilDivisor` level cannot produce prime divisors, and the concurrently-running `ajc-pic0av`
16	lane reported exactly that as the block on its χ-ledger port (AJC team thread `I-0493`).
17	
18	**What this file does, and what it deliberately does not do.**  It does not re-prove
19	`coheight ≤ 1`: that rests on a ~180-line standard-smooth/Kähler-differential argument in
20	`Adelic/FiniteMapToP1.lean`, and duplicating it upstream would be worse than the problem.
21	Instead it takes the bound as an explicit **hypothesis** and packages everything else, so the
22	producer is available at *every* import level and the geometric input can be discharged wherever
23	it happens to be in scope:
24	
25	* `Scheme.PrimeDivisor.ofNonGeneric` — from `Order.coheight z ≤ 1` and `z ≠ genericPoint X`,
26	  build the `PrimeDivisor`.  Its `coheight = 1` field is `le_antisymm` of the hypothesis and the
27	  elementary `one_le_coheight_of_ne_genericPoint` already in `WeilDivisor.lean`.
28	* `Scheme.PrimeDivisor.equivNonGeneric` — the resulting **equivalence of index sets**
29	  `X.PrimeDivisor ≃ {x // x ≠ genericPoint X}`, given the coheight bound at every point.  This
30	  is the sibling project's `CurveDivisor` index set, so this is the first of the two carrier
31	  mismatches `WeilDivisor.lean:1304-1311` lists as the cost of porting the sorry-free χ-ledger.
32	
33	The hypothesis form is the honest one here rather than a workaround: `coheight ≤ 1` is a genuine
34	curve hypothesis (it fails on any space of dimension `> 1`), so a producer that *assumes* it is
35	not weaker than one that proves it for a specific curve — it is the same content, reusable, and
36	it inverts no imports.  A consumer with `Adelic` in scope discharges it with
37	`Adelic.coheight_le_one_of_curve`; one without can carry it as a binder.
38	
39	## Provenance
40	
41	Rederived in AJC's own abstractions; nothing is ported.  The mathematics is the two-line
42	`le_antisymm` that `WeilDivisor.lean` describes but cannot state at its own import level, plus
43	the `Equiv` packaging.  Requested by `ajc-pic0av`; landed in `ajc-rr`'s file scope because

60	is at most one *is* a prime divisor.
61	
62	The coheight bound is the curve hypothesis, taken here as an argument rather than proved: see
63	the module docstring.  With `Adelic` in scope, discharge it by
64	`Adelic.coheight_le_one_of_curve C z`. -/
65	def ofNonGeneric {z : X} (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X) (hle : Order.coheight z ≤ 1) :
66	    X.PrimeDivisor where
67	  point := z
68	  coheight := le_antisymm hle (Scheme.one_le_coheight_of_ne_genericPoint hz)
69

theorem isConstantField_functionField (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsIntegral C.left] [IsLocallyNoetherian C.left]
    [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne C.left] :
    Adelic.IsConstantField k C.left where
  order_algebraMap_eq_zero P c hc := by
    letI : Algebra ↥Γ(C.left, ⊤) (C.left.presheaf.stalk P.point) :=
      C.left.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk
        (⟨P.point, trivial⟩ : (⊤ : C.left.Opens))
    haveI : IsScalarTower ↥Γ(C.left, ⊤) (C.left.presheaf.stalk P.point)
        C.left.functionField :=
      functionField_isScalarTower C.left ⊤ ⟨P.point, trivial⟩
    have h1 : algebraMap k C.left.functionField c
        = algebraMap ↥Γ(C.left, ⊤) C.left.functionField ((constMap C).hom c) := rfl
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap ↥Γ(C.left, ⊤) (C.left.presheaf.stalk P.point)
        ((constMap C).hom c)) :=
      ((isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hc).map (constMap C).hom).map _
    rw [h1, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ↥Γ(C.left, ⊤)
      (C.left.presheaf.stalk P.point) C.left.functionField]
    exact Scheme.RationalMap.order_algebraMap_eq_zero_of_isUnit P hu

/-- Scoped instance form of `isConstantField_functionField`. -/

    [IsIntegral C.left] [IsLocallyNoetherian C.left]
    [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne C.left] :
    Adelic.IsConstantField k C.left :=
